limitations: 43/48 is output token equality, not accuracy; equal baseline outputs include explicit conflicts.
Manual labels separate high-level compatibility from complete constraints; no RAG/motor executor was measured, and missing arguments are not automatically unrelated.
Whole-system prefix final logits are byte-identical, but internal per-layer KV tensors were not dumped; cannot claim all KV bytes were directly verified.
C1280/M16 isolation, not fastest C512/M32; no voice/RAG residency, no vision or motors.
Performance output1 measures TTFT only; natural/fixed decode timing has different lengths/diagnostic overhead and is not a paired decode benchmark.
Only one cost scene per cell with two repeats; no A-repeat baseline, no20boundary cases, modes run sequentially so thermal/frequency drift may affect comparisons.
Existing48 natural cases are reused regression sets, not fresh untouched validation.
RSS native boundary samples exclude much of NPU driver memory and Python/controller footprints; no wholeprocessPSS attribution.
CPU frequency samples are not NPU frequency.
